audit_items.proof_trace: Property claims publishing should only occur on subscribed subnets. The validator publishes ALL data columns (loop at L1018-1035) without checking subscription. Custody check at L1019-1029 only gates internal processing, not publishing. Publishing happens unconditionally at L1031-1034 for every column in the full 128-column matrix, regardless of whether the node subscribed to the corresponding subnet via its custody groups.
audit_items.attack_scenario: A proposer with custody_group_count=1 (subscribes to ~16 subnets out of 128) publishes all 128 data columns, flooding 112+ unsubscribed subnets. This violates the PeerDAS subnet load-balancing design, allowing resource exhaustion and scoring penalties from libp2p for publishing on unsubscribed topics.
